subject: SUP applicability correction: presentation validator revalidated on current main 633c75b
body: Correction to current-HEAD applicability only: GitHub main advanced during publication to child commit 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44. Revalidation is complete. The Gen6 base patcher remains exact blob ad666c8d193957bcda443ce253c5784f3a0298b2; FoldOverlayService remains cfc4706458e1da197e0e86ce74dc80c83489a2e6; PanelEngine remains 866d21ed1bd3fecfc25fffdcd3633489db9a80d9. New GEN6_BETA_HOTFIX_V1 patches hinge authority, physical+logical inner wake, terminal fencing and passive wallpaper, but does not patch FoldOverlayService/PanelEngine presentation-release logic or add FIRST_USEFUL/FIRST_INTERACTIVE receipts. Therefore the presentation-readiness finding, field validator and non-readiness invariants remain source-applicable at current main 633c75b. Passive wallpaper has converged into the hotfix candidate; exact native-presentation proof remains NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE. Previous message's statement that current main remained 699ed292 is superseded by this record; all other evidence/test results remain unchanged. No production writes.
